In [[Five-dimensional space|five-dimensional]] [[geometry]], a '''stericated 5-cube''' is a convex [[uniform 5-polytope]] with fourth-order [[Truncation (geometry)|truncations]] ([[sterication]]) of the regular [[5-cube]].

There are eight degrees of sterication for the 5-cube, including permutations of [[runcination]], [[cantellation]], and [[Truncation (geometry)|truncation]]. The simple stericated 5-cube is also called an '''expanded 5-cube''', with the first and last nodes ringed, for being [[constructible polygon|constructible]] by an [[Expansion (geometry)|expansion]] operation applied to the regular 5-cube. The highest form, the '''sterirunci{{wbr}}cantitruncated{{wbr}} 5-cube''', is more simply called an [[#Omnitruncated 5-cube|omnitruncated 5-cube]] with all of the nodes ringed.
{{clear}}

=== Alternate names ===
* Stericated penteract / Stericated 5-orthoplex / Stericated pentacross
* Expanded penteract / Expanded 5-orthoplex / Expanded pentacross
* Small cellated penteractitriacontaditeron (scant) (Jonathan Bowers){{sfn|Klitzing|at=[https://bendwavy.org/klitzing/incmats/scant.htm (x3o3o3o4x - scant)]}}

=== Coordinates ===
The [[Cartesian coordinate]]s of the vertices of a ''stericated 5-cube'' having edge length&nbsp;2 are all permutations of:

:<math>\left(\pm1,\ \pm1,\ \pm1,\ \pm1,\ \pm(1+\sqrt{2})\right)</math>

=== Images ===
The stericated 5-cube is constructed by a [[sterication]] operation applied to the 5-cube.

=== Dissections ===
The stericated 5-cube can be dissected into two [[Cupola (geometry)|tesseractic cupolae]] and a [[Runcinated tesseracts|runcinated tesseract]] between them. This dissection can be seen as analogous to the 4D runcinated tesseract being dissected into two [[Cubic cupola|cubic cupolae]] and a central [[rhombicuboctahedral prism]] between them, and also the 3D rhombicuboctahedron being dissected into two [[Square cupola|square cupolae]] with a central [[octagonal prism]] between them.{{5-cube Coxeter plane graphs|t04|150}}

{{5-cube Coxeter plane graphs|t01234|150}}

=== Full snub 5-cube ===
The '''full snub 5-cube''' or '''omnisnub 5-cube''', defined as an [[Alternation (geometry)|alternation]] of the omnitruncated 5-cube is not uniform, but it can be given Coxeter diagram {{CDD|node_h|4|node_h|3|node_h|3|node_h|3|node_h}} and [[Coxeter notation|symmetry]] [4,3,3,3]<sup>+</sup>, and constructed from 10 [[Runcinated tesseracts#Full snub tesseract|snub tesseract]]s, 32 [[Runcinated 5-cell#Full snub 5-cell|snub 5-cell]]s, 40 [[Truncated cuboctahedral prism#Related polytopes|snub cubic antiprism]]s, 80 [[Truncated octahedral prism#Related polytopes|snub tetrahedral antiprism]]s, 80 [[6-8 duoprism#Related polytopes|3-4 duoantiprism]]s, and 1920 irregular [[5-cell]]s filling the gaps at the deleted vertices.

== Related polytopes ==
The presented eight polytopes are from the family of 31 [[uniform 5-polytope]]s generated from the regular [[5-cube]] or [[5-orthoplex]].

{{Penteract family}}
